seo.title: About AquaVant | Fish vaccine specialists in Oslo
seo.description: AquaVant AS is an Oslo-based biotech company founded by fish-vaccine specialists with more than 45 years of combined experience.

page.intro1: AquaVant AS is an Oslo-based biotechnology and aquaculture company, founded by people who have spent their careers on fish vaccines.

s2.statement1: Our ambition is to become the dedicated adjuvant partner for fish vaccine manufacturers worldwide.
s2.soft1: Better vaccines mean healthier fish, and less need for antibiotics in aquaculture.

story.text1: Vaccines are one of the most important tools for keeping farmed fish healthy. The adjuvant is a critical part of an injectable fish vaccine, yet few suppliers specialise in adjuvants made for fish.
story.text2: Our founders saw that gap after decades of developing and registering fish vaccines for global animal-health companies. AquaVant was set up to fill it: a company that focuses on the adjuvant, and works through the manufacturers that make the vaccines.
story.text3: We are based in Oslo, close to one of the world’s leading aquaculture industries, and work with customers internationally.
